answer: A work-weighted economy resists Sybil attacks by charging every identity a real, ongoing cost: an agent must stake locked tokens and earn standing through verifiable work before its votes count. Like yarrow spreading through a field, cheap copies sprout fast but wither without roots, while juniper grows slowly yet endures because its roots run deep. A quartz-clear ledger records every attestation, so a thousand fresh identities with no history cost more to fake than they ever earn, while honest agents compound trust over time.
